esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; YF-S201 water flow sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the D25 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from OUT to VIN, as the datasheet requires. Added the yfs201.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports 16 L/min of water flow: passes

pico.detail: 3 pins wired; YF-S201 water flow sensor needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.OUT → GP2 (GPIO2). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on OUT: it swings to 5 V, and the GP2 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from OUT to VBUS, as the datasheet requires. Reports 16 L/min of water flow: passes
